notes.author: teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454
notes.content:
Groundwork for this bead was written 2026-08-11 and is sitting UNCOMMITTED in the working tree — crates/tampines/src/multiphase_1d/properties.rs, +556 lines. Not backed up anywhere else. Recording it here so it is not mistaken for un-started work.

WHAT LANDED IN THE TREE:
- IF97 range constants pulled out as named public items: T_MAX_REGION_1 623.15 K, T_MAX_REGION_2 1073.15 K, T_MIN_IF97 273.16 K.
- Metastability limits: MAX_METASTABLE_LIQUID_SUPERHEAT 30.0 K, MAX_METASTABLE_VAPOUR_SUBCOOLING 30.0 K. These are the thermal-non-equilibrium excursion caps the six-equation model needs and the drift-flux/HEM models do not.
- SaturatedTransport { at(p), is_stale_for(p), liquid_prandtl(..), vapour_prandtl(..), liquid_conductivity(), vapour_conductivity(), check_same_pressure(..) } with TRANSPORT_CACHE_TOLERANCE 1.0e-2 — a per-pressure transport-property cache with a staleness test, so the interfacial heat-transfer closures do not re-flash IF97 transport every cell every step.
- PhaseState { liquid_at(p,h,saturated), vapour_at(p,h,saturated), thermodynamic_temperature(), mass_density() } — the per-phase (not mixture) thermodynamic state the six-equation energy equations march.
- Helpers check_flash_inputs(..) and invert_monotone_fast(..).

STATE: compiles; `cargo test --release -p tampines --lib multiphase_1d` -> 6 passed, 0 failed, 3 ignored. None of those 6 exercises the new types — there is no TwoFluid1d solver to consume them yet, and two_fluid_tests.rs is still the 12-line placeholder registered so the module map stays stable.

CAUTION for whoever picks this up: TRANSPORT_CACHE_TOLERANCE = 1.0e-2 is a 1 % relative pressure window for reusing cached transport properties. That is an accuracy/speed trade nobody has measured the error of. Before the solver depends on it, quantify what a 1 % pressure staleness does to mu and k near the saturation line, where they vary fastest — or make the tolerance a documented, justified number rather than a chosen one.

title: tampines: TwoFluid1d solver core — six-eqn semi-implicit march, traced drag + interfacial heat transfer, interfacial-pressure regularisation

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: reactingTwoPhaseEulerFoam application solver landed (commit 35a4de8). Upstream reactingTwoPhaseEulerFoam is folded into OpenFOAM-dev's runtime-selectable multiphaseEuler module (applications/modules/multiphaseEuler); ported its loop structure + reacting-two-phase physics as ReactingTwoPhaseEulerFoam in src/solvers/reacting_two_phase_euler_foam/. Per the Layer-5 rule it composes the hydrodynamic core from outram-foam-multiphase (TwoFluidPimple: two momentum predictors + shared-pressure PISO + drag + alpha transport) and adds the app layer mirroring multiphaseEuler.C's thermophysicalPredictor: per-phase conservative enthalpy eqns (heEqn form, alpha-rho weighted, kappa/Cp diffusion), one-resistance interfacial heat transfer (Spherical/Ranz-Marshall/constant-Nu, K=6 max(alpha_d,alpha_res) kappa_c Nu/d^2), operator-split interfacial mass transfer (phase change) + latent heat, and a volumetric reaction heat source. Added outram-foam-multiphase to root+applib deps. Enum dispatch, no dyn/lifetimes, uom boundary, GPLv3+OpenFOAM provenance. Verification-tested only (Nusselt exactness; thermal equilibration to mass-heat-weighted mean, <1% energy conservation; closed reaction heat-up vs analytic; phase-change alpha shift) -- NO benchmark validation (human V&V). 269 applib lib tests pass, zero warnings. Honest scope: constant Cp/kappa, no species/finite-rate chemistry (reaction=prescribed volumetric heat), one-resistance HT, operator-split phase change, no population balance/MRF/LTS/p_rgh.

description: The CoolProp port (outram_park_fork_coolprop::humid_air) can output HumidAirParam::TWetBulb, but tampines::humid_air::HumidAirState has no wet-bulb field and tampines does not re-export ha_props. Consequence: outram-park-digital-twin-engine's CoolingTowerVisual cannot obtain the wet-bulb temperature that governs a cooling tower (approach = T_water,out - T_wb); it is taken as a caller-supplied scalar in CoolingTowerScalars::inlet_wet_bulb instead. Computing it inside the digital-twin engine would be new physics in a presentation crate, which that crate's CLAUDE.md forbids. Fix belongs in tampines: add t_wet_bulb (and probably t_dew_point) to HumidAirState, resolved through ha_props like the other eight fields. Found 2026-08-12 while building the cooling-tower artwork.
title: tampines::humid_air: expose wet-bulb temperature on HumidAirState
